$comment: CANONICAL VERIFIED SPECIFICATION ROWS — single source of truth for the three products that the supplied link.amazon codes resolve to. Every row was read live from the cited official page on 2026-11-14 (Amazon listing text / Amazon product-information block, or the manufacturer's own product page). Rules: a row exists only if an official page states the value; if two official pages disagree the row is status=conflict and shows BOTH values; if a value could not be confirmed it is absent here and is published as blank + flagged. Nothing is inferred, converted or filled in.
